original_finding_content.subject: Reddit seller speculates handling fee removal linked to Etsy Insider
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Reddit seller speculates that Etsy's removal of packaging/handling charges from calculated shipping is related to the Etsy Insider buyer loyalty program, where Etsy covers shipping costs.
**Verbatim snippet:** "I hate how they spin it as a way to help the sellers, when in fact it's to help themselves."
**Source:** https://www.reddit.com/r/EtsySellers/comments/1id0mrs/etsy_removing_packaginghandling_charges_from_our/
**source_type:** reddit
**verification_status:** could_not_verify
**Date:** January–March 2025
**Notes:** Reddit page could not be loaded directly. Snippet sourced from ValueAddedResource article (intermediary). Thread date predates the April 2025 window based on the January 30, 2025 article publication date. Excluded on both grounds: intermediary verification AND outside time window.
